Enabled.Name: Enable Effective Critical Hits
Enabled.Hint: On a critical hit, if the rolled damage is lower than the maximum damage of a normal hit, raise it to that maximum.

ShowNote.Name: Show note on damage cards
ShowNote.Hint: Add a short line to the damage chat card whenever a critical's damage was raised.

EFFECTIVECRITS.BreakdownTooltip: Added so the critical deals at least the maximum damage of a normal hit
EFFECTIVECRITS.Disabled: Effective Critical Hits has switched itself off because this version of the D&D 5e system isn't supported ({reason}). Critical hits follow the rules as written until the module is updated.
